note: Privacy Lock recall/precision floors (RV-04). Ratchet: measured recall must stay >= these per-category floors and the overall floor; a drop fails server/tests/test_lock_recall_gate.py. Regenerate the measured numbers with `PYTHONPATH=src python3 eval/lock_recall/measure_recall.py`; raise a floor when a fix improves recall so the gain is protected. Deterministic (Tier B regex + Tier B+ confusable only) — Tier C semantic recall needs a real-model eval and is not gated here.

precision.note: Loose guard, not a precision SLO. In a fail-closed system over-flagging is the safe direction, so the recall floors are load-bearing and this only catches runaway false alarms on ordinary clean prose (measured 0.0 at baseline).

known_gaps.iban: Space-grouped IBANs (the standard 4-char grouping, e.g. 'DE89 3704 0044 ...') are not caught by either IBAN pattern — only the greedy phone pattern fires. Contiguous IBANs are caught. Floor held at 0.5; fixing space-normalisation for IBAN would raise it to 1.0.
